title: Ishmael kills Gedaliah and takes the people captive
description: Ishmael, of royal lineage, kills the Babylonian governor Gedaliah in Mizpah, massacres visiting pilgrims and throws them into a cistern, and takes the king's daughters captive before fleeing to the Ammonites. [ref:Jer 41:1-10|Jeremiah 41:1-10]
